# Fallout 76 - Patch notes October 10, 2023 (Patch 47)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_221_nukaknights-post-patchnotes48.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

# FALLOUT 76 PATCH NOTES – OCTOBER 10, 2023 - Patch 47

Our latest update for Fallout 76 is released today, bringing with it a whole host of bug fixes, gameplay improvements and much more. Read on to check out the full patch notes for today's update.

**Update version**

Here you can find out the download size of today's patch on the respective platform:

**PC (Steam):** Version 1.81 - 9.24GB
**PC (Microsoft Store):** Version 1.0.87.0 - 9.8GB
**PlayStation:** Version 1.81 - 9.24GB
**Xbox:** Version 1.0.0.82 - 13.3GB

**Design Changes & Improvements**

**Gameplay:** We have adjusted the damage dealt by explosions themselves.
**Seasonal Events:** We've added new costumes and rewards to the Spooky Burnt and Trick-or-Treat seasonal events.

**Bug Fixes & Improvements**

**Armor and Power Armor**

**Power Armor:** Players can now equip Power Armor even if the lowest charged battery is also connected to a weapon.
**Plushes:** Plushes have been adjusted to provide more consistency in which displays they can be displayed in. Larger plush toys can no longer be displayed quite as often. NOTE: If some of your plushies are facing backwards in display cases, you may need to reposition them.
**Underarmor:** The Secret Service armor with the Winter Alaska paint scheme now uses the Secret Service Underarmor mod group rather than the Casual Underarmor mod group.
**Underarmor:** Fixed an issue that caused the Secret Service Underarmor preview to display the Winter Alaska Underarmor paint job.
**Armor:** The supported Raider armor mod now uses the correct model.
**Armor:** Arctic naval armor can now be given the following paint schemes: Red Viper, Free States, Nuclear Winter, and Nuclear Camouflage.
**Armor Mods:** The Legendary Aristocrat Armor Mod now increases health and energy damage resistance as expected as players gain more Caps.
**Armor Mods:** The Secret Service Armor can no longer be dropped with the Legendary Weightless Mod. Solar and thorn armor, however, can be looted with this mod.
**Armor Mods:** The Fiberglass Battle Armor Body Part Mod now gives proper damage resistances.
**Armor Mods:** All of the following mods now properly change appearance when applied: Pocketed, Clubbed, Deep Pocketed, Combat Armor, and Leather Armor.
**Clothing**

**Clothing:** The Winter Alaska Helmet will no longer appear as a Luchador Mask after crafting.
**Manufacture**

**Fermenting:** The Brewery Fermenter has been updated to prevent it from being placed in both public workshops and player housing.
**General:** Fixed a bug that prevented various items from appearing in the crafting menu, including: Auto Axe, Cold Shoulder, Union Power Armor, Makeshift Ronin Helmet, and Gladiator Mask.
**Prefabricated Buildings:** Fixed an issue that prevented players from placing items in the prefabricated Earthlight Lounge.
**Recipes:** Fixed a bug that caused recipes to only appear properly in the Workbench menu when the required Skill Cards were equipped.
**Decoration:** The tendril wall decoration is now also available in a half-wall version.
**Events**

**Mutated Events:** For mutated events, blueprint drop probability should now be closer to the expected percentage,
